modules.title: Read a Paint Coverage Statement
modules.review_needs:
- Have a paint subject-matter reviewer check the coverage-versus-hiding explanation.
- Confirm where participating stores can access current product data sheets.
- Verify any real product example before adding it.
- If media is added, check labels, accessibility descriptions, and usage rights.
- Keep project-area calculations and purchase-quantity estimates for Application modules.

modules.title: Supply Line or Drain Line?
modules.review_needs:

- If media is added, check accessibility descriptions and usage rights.

modules.title: Report a Shelf-Label Mismatch Clearly
modules.review_needs:
- Verify identifier terminology before publication.
- Review examples against participating stores’ label and checkout formats.
- Confirm reporting methods and the person responsible for resolving discrepancies.

- If media is added, check accessibility descriptions and usage rights.
- Keep pricing-law interpretation, inventory corrections, and root-cause investigation outside this module.
